115-D. Territorial Constituencies of Taluka Panchayats.—

—   The   Panchayat   as 
notified by the Government under section 7 of the Act, shall be a single territorial 
Constituency for the purpose of election to Taluka Panchayat. 
 115-E .   List of voters . —   The ward-wise list of voters prepared under section 13 of the 
Act, shall form the voters list of the respective Panchayat territorial Constituencies.
